amount.description: money: what came in, in the base currency, GST included.

cost.description: A partial disposal: the part of the asset's cost disposed of, in the base currency, above zero and below the cost; its accumulated depreciation and residual value go with it pro rata (ALLOC-PRORATA). Leave it out to dispose of the whole asset.

date.description: The day the asset was sold or written off: on or after its purchase, and not after today.

gst_code.description: money, when the organisation is GST-registered on the date: the sale's GST code for supplies, usually SR.

invoice_id.description: invoice: the issued invoice to the buyer.

invoice_line.description: invoice: its line for the asset, from 1, on the disposal clearing account.

money_account_id.description: money: the bank, cash or wallet account it came into: an active money account in the base currency.

notes.description: Notes kept with it: who bought it, why it was written off.

proceeds.description: money: received into a money account, recorded here and matched by bank import; invoice: an issued sales invoice to the buyer whose line is on the disposal clearing account; none: a write-off.
